idea: 应用分桶算子（bucket）对模板2平滑后的效率趋势进行离散化处理，将连续变化映射为五档，仅对前20%（极高改善）和后20%（极剧恶化）赋予非零权重，中间60%视为噪音剔除。此结构融合了模板1的极端区间交易思想与模板2的稳健趋势提取，通过清晰的头尾分层构建动量与反转的双向暴露。
expression_list: trade_when(or(greater(bucket(group_rank(ts_delta(ts_decay_linear(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 20), 5), industry), range="0,1,0.2"), 0.8), less(bucket(group_rank(ts_delta(ts_decay_linear(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 20), 5), industry), range="0,1,0.2"), 0.2)), group_zscore(ts_delta(ts_decay_linear(divide(anl69_eps_best_eeps_cur_yr, anl69_ebitda_best_eeps_cur_yr), 20), 5), industry), 0)
